subject.title: refactor(talk): return emitted events from the realtime session harness

question: Should `RealtimeVoiceInputAudioEvents`, `RealtimeVoiceOutputAudioEvents`, and `RealtimeVoiceOutputAudioDoneDetails` become supported Plugin SDK exports now, independently of the still-open Gateway-managed realtime session API?
rationale: This is a permanent external API boundary, not a mechanical relay refactor: the answer determines whether the new types must be documented, versioned, and compatibility-tested or kept internal.

options.title: Keep result types internal
options.body: Remove the three Plugin SDK re-exports and retain the return-event capability as an internal harness/relay implementation detail until the managed session API is accepted.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Keep the re-exports, explicitly define their stability and intended callers, and add focused public-surface compatibility coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep result types internal
recommendation.body: Remove the three Plugin SDK re-exports and retain the return-event capability as an internal harness/relay implementation detail until the managed session API is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa authored the stacked harness refactor and the dependent public realtime-session proposal, making them the best available routing candidate for the API decision context.
